raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`--moe-runner-backend humming` replaces every MoE sublayer tensor with a padded, repacked copy of a different size while loading. The originals stay referenced until the next sublayer, and later allocations split their cached blocks, so much of that memory is never returned. On 8× H20-3e (141 GB), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with TP-sharded experts holds 100.6 GB per GPU after loading at TP4 (81.8–82.2 GB with this PR) and 57.1 GB at TP8 (50.0 GB). At TP4, with or without DSpark, the server fails to start with the default `--mem-fraction-static 0.8` (TP4 + DSpark shown):

```
RuntimeError: The DSV4 SWA pool cap (707840 tokens, 15.81 GB) leaves no room for the full KV pool within the available 9.62 GB. ...
```

## Modifications

- After each sublayer transform, drop every reference to the replaced tensors (including the loop variables) and call `torch.cuda.empty_cache()`, in both Humming MoE paths. Padding, kernels and the forward pass are unchanged.
- CPU unit test `test_humming_moe_release_replaced.py`: no replaced tensor is still referenced when the cache is emptied, for both paths. It fails on main.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K (`python -m sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k`, 1319 questions):

| | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| TP4 | fails to start | 0.913 |
| TP4 + DSpark | fails to start | 0.919 / 0.920 / 0.926 |
| TP8 | 0.920 / 0.926 / 0.919 | 0.920 / 0.926 / 0.920 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

8× H20-3e, `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-20261019-3c560089`, the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash H200 low-latency cookbook recipe with `--moe-runner-backend humming --ep-size 1`, `SGLANG_HUMMING_INPUT_QUANT_CONFIG='{"dtype": "float8e4m3"}'` and `SGLANG_ENABLE_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_TABLE=1`. Decode: `python -m sglang.bench_serving --dataset-name random-ids --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 512`; TP8 is the mean of 3 alternating runs on one node.

| | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| TP4: weights per GPU | 100.6 GB, fails to start | 81.8–82.2 GB, KV 10.18M tokens |
| TP4 + DSpark | fails to start | KV 6.92–7.02M tokens |
| TP8: weights per GPU / KV tokens | 57.1 GB / 26.2–26.6M | 50.0 GB / 31.1M |
| TP8: output tok/s, c1 / c32 / c64 | 149.6 / 1795 / 2452 | 150.3 / 1790 / 2435 |
| TP8: median TPOT at c64 | 20.40 ms | 20.41 ms |

With #45083 (TP4 + CP4 + DSpark), KV grows from 4.88M to 10.88M tokens. Loading is not slower. With Humming's generic SM90 heuristics (the ones H100/H200 select) forced on the same machine, the memory numbers are the same and TP4 + DSpark starts.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -0,0 +1,170 @@
+"""Humming MoE weight preparation must free the tensors each sublayer transform replaces."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import contextlib
+import unittest
+import weakref
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization import humming as humming_mod  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization import humming_utils  # noqa: E402
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+NUM_EXPERTS, HIDDEN, INTERMEDIATE = 4, 64, 96
+
+
+class _ConvertedSchema:
+    """Stands in for the Humming-format weight schema returned by the conversion."""
+
+
+class _TransformRecorder:
+    """Fakes the Humming conversion and transform and records what is alive when
+    the CUDA cache is emptied."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.events: list[str] = []
+        # Converted tensors and the parameters wrapping them; all of these are
+        # replaced by the transform and must be unreferenced afterwards.
+        self.replaced: list[weakref.ref] = []
+
+    def convert_humming(self, tensors, **kwargs):
+        out = {name: tensor.clone() for name, tensor in tensors.items()}
+        self.replaced += [weakref.ref(tensor) for tensor in out.values()]
+        return _ConvertedSchema(), out
+
+    def convert_tensors(self, weight_schema, input_schema, tensors, **kwargs):
+        schema, out = self.convert_humming(tensors)
+        return schema, input_schema, out
+
+    def transform_humming_layer(self, layer, sublayer_name=None):
+        # Like the real transform: every sublayer tensor is swapped for a padded
+        # copy of a different size.
+        for name, param in list(layer.named_parameters()):
+            if name.startswith(f"{sublayer_name}_"):
+                self.replaced.append(weakref.ref(param))
+                padded = torch.zeros(
+                    param.shape[0], param.shape[1] + 32, *param.shape[2:]
+                )
+                delattr(layer, name)
+                setattr(layer, name, torch.nn.Parameter(padded, requires_grad=False))
+        del param
+        self.events.append(f"transform:{sublayer_name}")
+
+    def empty_cache(self):
+        alive = sum(ref() is not None for ref in self.replaced)
+        self.events.append(f"empty_cache(alive={alive})")
+
+    def patches(self):
+        not_deepep = SimpleNamespace(is_deepep=lambda: False)
+        humming_method = SimpleNamespace(
+            prepare_layer_meta=lambda **kwargs: None,
+            transform_humming_layer=self.transform_humming_layer,
+        )
+        return [
+            patch.object(humming_utils, "get_moe_a2a_backend", return_value=not_deepep),
+            patch.object(humming_utils, "HummingMethod", humming_method),
+            # humming.py imports Humming lazily; HummingMethod is None until then.
+            patch.object(humming_mod, "HummingMethod", humming_method),
+            patch.object(
+                humming_mod,
+                "_convert_humming_tensors",
+                side_effect=self.convert_tensors,
+            ),
+            patch.object(torch.cuda, "empty_cache", side_effect=self.empty_cache),
+        ]
+
+
+def _make_moe_layer() -> torch.nn.Module:
+    layer = torch.nn.Module()
+    shapes = {
+        "w13_weight": (NUM_EXPERTS, 2 * INTERMEDIATE, HIDDEN // 2),
+        "w13_weight_scale": (NUM_EXPERTS, 2 * INTERMEDIATE, HIDDEN // 32),
+        "w2_weight": (NUM_EXPERTS, HIDDEN, INTERMEDIATE // 2),
+        "w2_weight_scale": (NUM_EXPERTS, HIDDEN, INTERMEDIATE // 32),
+    }
+    for name, shape in shapes.items():
+        param = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(shape), requires_grad=False)
+        layer.register_parameter(name, param)
+    return layer
+
+
+EXPECTED_EVENTS = [
+    "transform:w13",
+    "empty_cache(alive=0)",
+    "transform:w2",
+    "empty_cache(alive=0)",
+]
+
+
+class TestHummingMoeReleaseReplaced(CustomTestCase):
+    def _run(self, recorder: _TransformRecorder, fn):
+        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
+            for p in recorder.patches():
+                stack.enter_context(p)
+            fn()
+
+    def test_prepare_humming_moe_layer(self):
+        recorder = _TransformRecorder()
+        layer = _make_moe_layer()
+        layer.num_local_experts = NUM_EXPERTS
+        layer.hidden_size = HIDDEN
+        layer.intermediate_size_per_partition = INTERMEDIATE
+        layer.params_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+        layer.with_bias = False
+        layer.layer_name = "model.layers.0.mlp.experts"
+        schema = SimpleNamespace(convert_humming=recorder.convert_humming)
+        input_schema = SimpleNamespace(
+            convert_humming=lambda **kwargs: (SimpleNamespace(), {})
+        )
+        input_schema_cls = MagicMock(return_value=input_schema)
+        input_schema_cls.from_config.return_value = input_schema
+
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                humming_utils.BaseWeightSchema, "from_config", return_value=schema
+            ),
+            patch.object(humming_utils, "HummingInputSchema", input_schema_cls),
+        ):
+            self._run(
+                recorder,
+                lambda: humming_utils.prepare_humming_moe_layer(
+                    layer, {"quant_method": "mxfp4"}
+                ),
+            )
+
+        self.assertEqual(recorder.events, EXPECTED_EVENTS)
+
+    def test_humming_moe_method(self):
+        recorder = _TransformRecorder()
+        layer = _make_moe_layer()
+        layer.sublayer_configs = {
+            "w13": {"shape_n": 2 * INTERMEDIATE, "shape_k": HIDDEN, "stack_size": 2},
+            "w2": {"shape_n": HIDDEN, "shape_k": INTERMEDIATE, "stack_size": 1},
+        }
+        layer.param_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+        layer.num_experts = NUM_EXPERTS
+        layer.with_bias = False
+
+        method = humming_mod.HummingMoEMethod.__new__(humming_mod.HummingMoEMethod)
+        method.weight_schema = SimpleNamespace()
+        method.input_schema = SimpleNamespace()
+        method.force_weight_schema = None
+        method.force_input_schema = None
+
+        self._run(recorder, lambda: method.process_weights_after_loading(layer))
+
+        self.assertEqual(recorder.events, EXPECTED_EVENTS)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
